_doc: Single source of truth for coverage thresholds. See REPO-STANDARDS-SPEC [COVERAGE-THRESHOLDS-JSON] and docs/specs/SPEC.md. Ratchet only — never lower. Each Rust crate and the webview have their own line-coverage floor; every test target `make ci` runs must measure against its entry here ([TEST-SELECTION]: `make test` filters no test by name; only the feature-gated corpus suite is out). One sanctioned exception: the extension host's out/** code has no measurable coverage channel (gh #440) — the desktop extension host ignores NODE_V8_COVERAGE for plain-Mocha suites, so no floor exists for it until the suites migrate to the Testing API.
